candidate_evidence.quote: Subjects determined as having met inclusion criteria through screening will be randomized into treatment groups (CAN008 + RT + TMZ, 78 subjects) and the control group (placebo + RT + TMZ, 39 subjects) in a ratio of 2:1.

role_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] CAN008: CAN008 IV infusion weekly (interventions: Drug: CAN008)
To evaluate the efficacy of CAN008 plus temozolomide (TMZ) treatment in subjects with newly diagnosed glioblastoma (GBM) during and after radiation therapy

agents.drug_class_hint: CD95 (Fas) ligand-blocking Fc fusion protein; other name APG101 (asunercept)

role_evidence.quote: Period 1 (W1-W6) is the triple therapy period in which subjects in both groups will be given placebo + RT + TMZ.

coder_notes: Temozolomide is not a registered intervention but both groups receive RT + TMZ. Placebo not listed (no active moiety). Record gives other name APG101 but no INN; moiety coded as development code can008. Intervention text oddly says 'subjects in both groups will be given CAN008 + RT + TMZ' (likely copy error); arms/description make CAN008 experimental-arm only.
